subject.title: Add an official Featherless AI provider plugin

question: Should OpenClaw accept Featherless AI as an official external provider plugin with an @openclaw package, onboarding choice, and release path?
rationale: The request adds new official provider, auth, CLI flag, env var, docs, package, and release surface; the linked maintainer PR is implementation-ready context, but product ownership must be confirmed before this issue closes.

options.title: Review the linked provider PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101092 as the canonical implementation review and close this issue only after that PR lands or is rejected.

options.title: Narrow to ClawHub-only distribution
options.body: If official package ownership is too high-cost, reject the official-provider path and ask for a third-party ClawHub provider package instead.

options.title: Keep generic custom-provider setup
options.body: If Featherless should not get first-class support, document that generic custom-provider configuration remains the supported path and close the paired work with that rationale.

recommendation.title: Review the linked provider PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101092 as the canonical implementation review and close this issue only after that PR lands or is rejected.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc opened the issue, owns the linked implementation PR, and is the clearest current sponsor for the provider/package decision.
